senses.gloss: c. = h. חָם II, warm, hot, fresh.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 21:7">Targ. I Sam. XXI, 7</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:1:6">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵃ</cite> bot., a. e. <he>פיתא ח׳</he> fresh bread.
<cite ref="Eruvin 3a:25">Erub. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 24b:11">B. Bath. 24ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>קדרא … לא ח׳ וכ׳</he> a pot belonging to two partners is neither warm nor cold.
Ḥull. 6ᵇ בר … ליכול ח׳ let the scholar eat fresh food, and I shall be contented with cold; a. fr.—Pl. חַמִּימִין, חַמִּימֵי hot water (v. חָם II).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:11:4">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חמר וח׳</he> wine mixed with hot water.

<cite ref="Shabbat 55a:2">Sabb. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>רישך בקרירי … בח׳</he> thy chief (I) shall be punished with cold water, but thy chief’s chief (the Resh Galutha) with boiling water (he is reponsible); a. e.
